title: Route of the travels of the Israelites 40 years in the desert (Amsterdam Haggadah map, 1695)
summary: Hebrew map by Abraham ben Jacob (Amsterdam, 1695) showing the route of the Israelites from the Nile through the wilderness and the tribal allotments of the Holy Land (LoC devised English title).
